name: Radiation countermeasures: government stockpiles & defense
problem_set: Treating internalized plutonium, uranium and other actinides after a radiological or nuclear incident
Current therapies for radionuclide contamination are limited
Oral options for emergency medical use
value_prop: The founder's papers report that 3,4,3-LI(1,2-HOPO) showed much higher actinide-removal efficacy than DTPA in preclinical work and was well tolerated orally in rats.

name: Radiopharmaceutical imaging (89Zr PET)
problem_set: Chelators that hold 89Zr stably in vivo
89Zr released from DFO accumulates in bone
Background radiation dose from PET tracers
value_prop: The founder's 89Zr paper reports Zr-HOPO stability that matched or surpassed DFO in every experiment, with rapid clearance in healthy mice.

name: Gadolinium removal after MRI contrast (contrast-agent makers)
problem_set: Gadolinium deposits in brain, bones and other organs after MRI
Regulatory pressure on gadolinium-based contrast agents
Remedy for patients who need contrast-enhanced MRI
value_prop: The founder's gadolinium paper reports that 3,4,3-LI(1,2-HOPO) was more effective than DTPA at chelating and removing gadolinium and may mitigate Gd retention.

name: Lead & heavy-metal poisoning (public health)
problem_set: Removal of toxic heavy metals such as lead and cadmium
Oral chelation options for metal exposure
value_prop: A published study reports Pb, Cd and Sn complexation by 3,4,3-LI(1,2-HOPO); no buyer in the current list shows a lead or cadmium signal yet.
